value.reason: Calling `app.use(cors())` with no options applies the cors middleware globally with its default `origin: '*'`, so every route sends `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`. This matches SEC-11-ts-wildcard-cors. The snippet alone doesn't show whether the app has truly public, unauthenticated-only endpoints, so that context could change the severity, but the wildcard policy itself is what the rule flags.
